description: Structured test cases and natural-language prompt benchmarks for FPAC Soil MCP Server tools, resources, and prompt templates.

test_cases.user_prompt: Using the FPPA screening explanation tool, explain the difference between preliminary SDA soil screening under 7 CFR Part 657 and a formal FPPA LESA determination or Form AD-1006 / NRCS-CPA-106 under 7 CFR Part 658.
expected_facts: SDA soil screening is preliminary soil inventory information under 7 CFR Part 657.
The service does not perform formal LESA scoring or issue official FPPA findings under 7 CFR Part 658.
Formal FPPA evaluation uses Form AD-1006 or Form NRCS-CPA-106 (corridor-type projects) and is coordinated with USDA NRCS.
guidelines: The response states that results are preliminary screening and are not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, Form AD-1006, or Form NRCS-CPA-106.

test_cases.user_prompt: List all official USDA NRCS SSURGO farmland classification categories, their definitions, and their FPPA protection status.
What is the USDA soil map unit, farmland classification, and FPPA status at latitude 41.8781, longitude -93.0977 (Marshall County, IA)?
expected_facts: The SSURGO map unit at the point is mukey 409406 (symbol 120B).
The map unit is Tama silty clay loam, 2 to 5 percent slopes.
The SSURGO farmland classification is 'All areas are prime farmland'.
The point is in Marshall County, IA.
guidelines: The response states that results are preliminary screening and are not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, Form AD-1006, or Form NRCS-CPA-106.

test_cases.user_prompt: Can you check the soil map unit and farmland classification for latitude 39.7684 and longitude -87.1581?
Retrieve the official farmland classification and soil map unit details for SSURGO map unit key (mukey) 412850.
expected_facts: Map unit 412850 is Fayette silty clay loam, till plain, 14 to 18 percent slopes, eroded (symbol M163E2).
The SSURGO farmland classification is 'Farmland of statewide importance'.
The soil survey area symbol is IA153.
guidelines: The response states that results are preliminary screening and are not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, Form AD-1006, or Form NRCS-CPA-106.

test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze the farmland classification and acreage breakdown for this proposed solar farm parcel in Story County, IA: {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[-93.65, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.02]]]}. Please include NCCPI crop productivity index ratings and check for Census 2020 urban area overlap.

Retrieve the clipped SSURGO soil map unit polygon boundaries and properties as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection for the following project boundary: POLYGON((-93.65 42.02, -93.63 42.02, -93.63 42.04, -93.65 42.04, -93.65 42.02))

Screen this commercial project site in Des Moines, IA against Census 2020 Urban Area boundaries (Layer 0) to check if it qualifies for an FPPA statutory exemption under 7 CFR § 658.2(a): POLYGON((-93.62 41.58, -93.60 41.58, -93.60 41.60, -93.62 41.60, -93.62 41.58))
Retrieve the component-weighted National Commodity Crop Productivity Index (NCCPI v3) ratings for SSURGO map unit keys 412850, 412851, and 413100.
expected_facts: Map unit 412850 has a weighted-average NCCPI v3 rating of about 0.72 (within 0.01), rated moderately high inherent productivity.
Map unit 412851 has a weighted-average NCCPI v3 rating of about 0.59 (within 0.01), rated moderately low inherent productivity.
Map unit key 413100 is reported as having no NCCPI rating.
guidelines: The response states that results are preliminary screening and are not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, Form AD-1006, or Form NRCS-CPA-106.
The response explicitly reports that no rating was returned for map unit key 413100 and does not invent, infer, or substitute a rating for it.

test_cases.user_prompt: Perform a complete FPPA corridor screening and Form NRCS-CPA-106 LESA evaluation for a proposed 230kV transmission line: Centerline: LINESTRING(-93.62 42.02, -93.55 42.08, -93.45 42.15), Corridor Width: Buffer 75 feet on each side (150-ft total right-of-way), Indirect Staging Yard: POLYGON((-93.56 42.07, -93.54 42.07, -93.54 42.09, -93.56 42.09, -93.56 42.07)), Site Assessment Inputs: Project farm tract size is 350 acres. Please partition by county, query NASS agricultural statistics, apply 7 CFR § 658.5(c) corridor rules, and evaluate whether the total LESA score exceeds 160 points.

Compare two highway bypass alignments for FPPA farmland conversion impact: Primary Alignment: LINESTRING(-93.60 42.00, -93.50 42.10) with 100-foot buffer, versus Alternative Alignment B: LINESTRING(-93.62 42.00, -93.58 42.06, -93.50 42.10) with 100-foot buffer. Which route minimizes Prime Farmland conversion?
Read the MCP resource fppa://regulatory-notice (or call fpac-soil_read_get_regulatory_notice_resource) and summarize the FPPA regulatory notice and statutory limitations.
expected_facts: SDA farmland classification attributes provide preliminary soil inventory information under 7 CFR Part 657.
A query does not constitute an official FPPA determination, LESA score, or completion of Form AD-1006 / NRCS-CPA-106.
Formal FPPA determinations require coordination with the appropriate USDA NRCS State or local office.
guidelines: The response states that results are preliminary screening and are not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, Form AD-1006, or Form NRCS-CPA-106.

test_cases.user_prompt: Read the MCP resource fppa://screening-guidance (or call fpac-soil_read_get_screening_guidance_resource) explaining the distinction between Form AD-1006 and Form NRCS-CPA-106.
Read the MCP resource fppa://farmland-classes (or call fpac-soil_read_get_farmland_classes_resource) containing SSURGO farmland categories.
Use the fppa_screening_assistant prompt to evaluate a proposed 50-acre rural water treatment facility in Boone County, IA at -93.88, 42.05.
Use the fppa_corridor_screening_assistant prompt to guide us through an 18-mile multi-county pipeline right-of-way evaluation under 7 CFR § 658.5(c).
Use the fppa_urban_exemption_assistant prompt to evaluate a proposed logistics park expansion on the fringe of Cedar Rapids, IA.
Use the fppa_site_assessment_assistant prompt to evaluate Part VI Site Assessment criteria and Form AD-1006 decision thresholds for a new USDA-funded community health facility.

Calculate a preliminary LESA score for the 'Maple Valley Substation' site project using NCCPI productivity index: {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[-93.65, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.02]]]}. Site assessment inputs include 120 awarded points across Part VI criteria with project farm size of 180 acres and county average farm size of 320 acres. Explain the 160-point protection-consideration guidance under 7 CFR § 658.4(c)(2)-(4), without treating it as requiring selection of an alternative.

Perform a complete preliminary Form AD-1006 LESA calculation for a proposed 45-acre regional medical clinic in Story County, IA: POLYGON((-93.58 42.01, -93.57555 42.01, -93.57555 42.01445, -93.58 42.01445, -93.58 42.01)). Use national NCCPI as the productivity index and evaluate whether comprehensive site assessment scoring requires consideration of alternative non-farmland sites.

Guide me through the Site Assessment questions using the published criteria resource. Ask for the criterion-specific evidence that is missing; do not assign points, select a site, or recommend an alternative.
expected_facts: Unknown Site Assessment criteria remain unknown until supported evidence is supplied; the response asks for missing evidence rather than assigning points.
The response identifies the discussion as preliminary and not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, or completed form.
guidelines: Do not invent subjective Site Assessment points or recommend or select a site, footprint, or alternative.
Any retrieval path to the Site Assessment criteria (get_prompt, read_resource, or explain_fppa_screening_scope) is acceptable.

test_cases.user_prompt: For project Synthetic SA-MA-02, use project_type site and calculate the preliminary LESA result using NCCPI for this AOI: {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[-93.65, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.02]]]}. No Part VI Site Assessment facts or farm-size inputs are available. Report missing criteria as unavailable or incomplete, not zero; do not invent points or claim a threshold result from an unevaluable total.
expected_facts: The requested calculator input is a GeoJSON site polygon with no Site Assessment facts or farm-size inputs supplied.
Missing Part VI facts remain unavailable or incomplete rather than being treated as zero.
An unevaluable total is not presented as meeting or failing the statutory threshold.
The result is preliminary and not an official FPPA determination, LESA score, or completed form.
guidelines: Do not fabricate subjective Site Assessment points, treat missing inputs as zero, or claim a threshold result from an unevaluable total.
The agent may retrieve regulatory context resources before calling the calculation tool.

test_cases.user_prompt: I have no criterion-specific Site Assessment evidence or site comparisons yet. Explain the regulatory consequence of that limitation and what information would be needed, without assigning points or selecting a site, footprint, or preferred alternative.
expected_facts: No Site Assessment points or site preference can be supported without criterion-specific evidence and site comparisons.
The response describes preliminary screening and does not present an official FPPA determination or completed form.
guidelines: Do not invent Site Assessment points or recommend or select a site, footprint, or preferred alternative.
Any retrieval path to the Site Assessment criteria (get_prompt, read_resource, or explain_fppa_screening_scope) is acceptable.

test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze this synthetic Iowa AOI with the validated CSR2 productivity index: {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[-93.65, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.02], [-93.63, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.04], [-93.65, 42.02]]]}. Explain which productivity index the tool used, preserve the returned rating provenance and coverage status, and state when evidence is unavailable rather than silently substituting NCCPI.
expected_facts: CSR2 is the primary productivity index for scoring; NCCPI may appear as supplementary national-baseline context but does not replace CSR2.
Rating provenance and coverage are reported from the tool result; unavailable evidence is identified rather than inferred.
The result is preliminary and not an official FPPA determination or LESA score.
guidelines: Do not invent ratings, provenance, or coverage. CSR2 must remain the primary productivity index; supplementary NCCPI context alongside it is acceptable.
